title: Professional Certificate Course in Project Procurement Risk Management
description: The aim of this course is to provide comprehensive understanding in mitigating project procurement risks.
longDescription: Our Professional Certificate Course in Project Procurement Risk Management offers in-depth knowledge and skills to effectively manage procurement risks in projects. The course covers the concept of procurement risk and its various types, including e-procurement risks and their causes and types. Participants will also gain practical knowledge on risk probability framework, risk scoring, and risk impact ranges, along with an understanding of the procurement risk cycle. By the end of the course, participants will be equipped with the necessary expertise to identify, assess, and mitigate procurement risks to ensure project success.
